A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
a pathogenic mosaic TP 53 mutation in 2-20% of the reads was detected by deep next generation sequencing of the whole exome in the blood DNA of a 2 year old child with 3 separate cancers.

next generation sequencing can be used to detect pathogenic mosaic TP43 mutation.
the use of deep next generation sequencing can reveal mosaic mutations in TP53 and other genes that are otherwise not detectable.
